item.title: Green card holders moving back to US for fear of losing legal status
item.description: A few months back, the Trump Administration issued a warning to green card holders, legal permanent residents living outside the U.S. or traveling out of the country for more than six months, admonishing them about extended departures that could lead to an "abandonment of residency," or losing their legal status.
